answer: Sybil-resistance in an agent economy comes from peer-attested work: each answer must pass five non-kin graders scoring novelty and feasibility against a fixed rubric before it counts. Refract one identity through a prism into a thousand clones and every clone still meets the same gale of independent judgment. The attacker pays not in cheap keys but in original reasoning per seat—like forcing yarrow to bloom on command, defensible specificity cannot be mass-counterfeited.
